pages.title: Overview
pages.text:
A Nether-themed melee weapon. Base damage 8, attack speed 2.0, matching the Netherite Sword.

Owner effects (not triggered by dolls)
• Fire Resistance while held (main hand or offhand)
• Attacks set the target on fire for 4s
• Grants 6 golden hearts (12 absorption, consumed before your own HP, fades when put down) while held
• Charge right-click for 1s to summon a flying sword

pages.title: Flying Nether Sword
pages.text:
• Hovers behind the player
• Auto-attacks the nearest hostile mob within 16 blocks
• Dive-bomb: 8 damage + ignite for 8s
• Only one active at a time; summoning again replaces the old one

While a doll holds this sword, its burn durations are all doubled: melee 16s, flame arrow 16s, fireball 10s.
